every_position_composed.reason: Site 1 maintains a continuous linear travel along the assembly line across frames 1-9 without losing the UI card, whereas Site 2 loses its explanatory card completely in transition frames 4 and 7 and clips an out-of-focus foreground object in frame 8.

explains_the_project.reason: Site 1's linear pipeline clearly visualizes the step-by-step flow from log compression (frame 3) to local storage (frame 5), line-shift caliper anchoring (frame 6), and multi-lane gates (frame 8).

craft_of_the_3d.reason: Site 2's machinery in frames 4-8 features more refined bevels, cohesive matte-metallic surface shading, and grounded contact shadows compared to Site 1's starker geometry in frame 6.

type_and_layout.reason: Site 2 uses labeled top navigation and cleaner typographic spacing—avoiding text bugs like Site 1's 'ONE20,001-LINE' in frame 1—though both position cards cleanly away from the focal 3D models.

overall.reason: Site 1 better fulfills the request by turning Straitjacket's architecture into an intuitive, uninterrupted 3D assembly-line scroll where every position stays composed and legible.
